chunks: If a wound touches you, a similar wound has already touched the people. And We alternate the nights and days among men, so that Allah may know those who believe, and take for Himself witnesses from among you; and Allah does not love the unjust.
ai.seo_question: What is the wisdom behind alternating success and failure in human affairs according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Battle of Uhud, illustrating that physical wounds are a natural part of the human condition, while divine decree alternates the tides of war to test the steadfastness of the faithful. It emphasizes that martyrdom and true belief are revealed through enduring these trials, serving as a mechanism for Allah to distinguish the sincere from the hypocrites. The phrase 'We alternate them among the people' highlights the cyclical nature of worldly power as a divine instrument for spiritual purification.
